cities.name: Myrtle Beach
cities.localNotes: Myrtle Beach's median single-family sale price was about $525,000 in 2025, up from about $515,000 in 2024 (Coastal Carolinas Association of REALTORS data reported by MyHorryNews). Homes across Horry County sold for roughly 95-98% of list price in 2025.

cities.name: Conway
cities.localNotes: Conway's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $312,000, up from about $299,000 in 2024. It is the county seat and home to Coastal Carolina University, and it draws families looking for more space at lower prices than the beach.

cities.name: North Myrtle Beach
cities.localNotes: North Myrtle Beach's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $560,000, slightly down from about $573,000 in 2024. Many properties are second homes or short-term rentals, and the city has its own short-term rental rules.

cities.name: Carolina Forest
cities.localNotes: Carolina Forest's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $445,000, up from about $425,000 in 2024. Newer construction and larger lots make it popular with families and remote workers.

cities.name: Surfside Beach
cities.localNotes: Surfside Beach's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $410,000, up from about $395,000 in 2024. Lower-maintenance homes near the beach draw many retirees.

cities.name: Little River
cities.localNotes: Little River's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $355,000, slightly down from about $368,000 in 2024. Its older population has grown quickly, with many newcomers arriving from outside the county.

cities.name: Socastee
cities.localNotes: Socastee's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $360,000, up slightly from about $355,000 in 2024.

cities.name: Loris
cities.localNotes: The Loris and Longs area had a 2025 median single-family sale price of about $302,000, among the most affordable in Horry County.

cities.name: Aynor
cities.localNotes: Aynor is a small inland town in western Horry County. Its 2025 median single-family sale price was about $317,000, up from about $311,000 in 2024.
